( cf CPD: ‘harmless and offenceless’ ); Pv 42:10 (etādisaṃ … appaduṭṭhapadosinaṃ paccanti pāpakammantā isim āsajja subbataṃ; cf Pv-a 266, 8 : appaduṭṭhapadosinaṃ isiṃ subbataṃ āsajja āsādetvā pāpakammantā puggalā … paccantī ti); — caus. pr. 3 sg. padūseti [ S. pradūṣayati; perhaps not to be distinguished from padūseti 2 qv ], defiles, pollutes; Vin II 203, 14* foll. [ S. pradūṣita], corrupted, spoiled; It 13, 8* (cittaṃ hi ’ssa ~itaṃ; or padūsita 2 ); It-a I 72, 9 (dosena rāgādinā ~itacittaṃ).

[ or to appaduṭṭha 1 ], not bearing ill-will; not hostile; ( who has done no wrong; ?); Sn 662 (yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati; Pj II 478, 9 : padosābhāvena appaduṭṭho); Dhp-a III 70, 15 (appaduṭṭhesū ti paresu vā attani vā niraparādhesu); Pv-a 116, 9 (appaduṭṭhe hitajjhāsayasampanne); — fpp ( a ) padussitabba, ( mf ) n., impers. , Vism 381, 29 (na appaduṭṭhassa padussitabban ti, Ce, Se so; Ee dussitabban ti; Be appaduṭṭhassa nappadussitabban ti); ( b ) neg. appadussiya, mfn. , Saddh 312 (āpadāsu sahāyo me abhejjo appadussiyo); — caus. pr. 3 sg. padūseti , ~ayati, padoseti, padosayati, padusseti, padussayati [ perhaps not to be distinguished from padūseti 1 qv; cf BHS pradūṣayati], makes hostile towards (loc.); fills with enmity or anger; D I 20, 17 (te … aññamaññamhi cittāni ~enti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se padosenti); M I 129, 16 (tatrāpi yo mano ~eyya) = 186, 13 ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se padoseyya); S I 149, 27* (yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye; Spk I 216, 9 : cittaṃ ~eyya, Ce, Ee so; Be padusseyya; Se ~aye) = Sn 659 quoted Nett 132, 30* ; Vism 305, 23 (tatra me nappatirūpaṃ manaṃ ~etun ti); Spk I 131, 29 (amhesu manaṃ ~essati, Ce so; Be, Ee padosessati; Se dosessati); 282, 23 (cittaṃ ~essanti); Ud-a 65, 25 (ayaṃ yakkho mayi idha nisinne cittaṃ ~eti); — part.pr. padūsayamāna, padussayamāna, mfn. , Nidd-a I 322, 2 (mano ~ayamāno uppajjatī ti manopadoso, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se padussayamāno) = As 367, 25 ( Be, Ce so; Ee padussayamāno; Se padusayamāno); — aor. 3 sg. padūsesi, Vism 302, 9 (paccatthikesu cittaṃ nappadūsesi); 1 sg. padussesiṃ, Ap-a 288, 37 (buddhaṃ āsādayiṃ ghaṭṭesiṃ, padussesin ti attho); 2 pl. padūsayittha, padosayittha, Pj II 307, 18 (attano jīvitaṃ vināsentesu pi mā mano ~ayitthā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee padosayitthā ti); 1 pl. padūsimha, D I 21, 4 (te mayaṃ … aññamaññamhi cittāni ~imha, Ce, Ee so; Be ~imhā; Se padosimha) = III 33, 5 ( Ee so; Be, Ce ~imhā; Se padosiyimha); — absol. ( a ) padūsetvā, Ja V 273, 4´ ; Spk II 195, 24 ; Dhp-a III 343, 10 (tumhesu manaṃ ~etvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se padussitvā); — neg. appadūsetvā, Vism 303, 29 ; ( b ) padosetvā, Sv 610, 17 (ujjhāyantā manaṃ padosetvā); Pv-a 212, 11 ; — pp padūsita 2 , mfn. , hostile; filled with ill-will; It 13, 8* (cittaṃ hi ’ssa ~itaṃ; or perhaps padūsita 1 ).
